attributes.label: Hide background at this breakpoint
attributes.help: Hides the background layer of this block at this breakpoint and restores it at the next visible one.

attributes.label: Background columns
attributes.help: Width of the background layer's grid column, independent of the block's own column width.

attributes.label: Show background
attributes.help: Turns on the background layer below — its color, overlay and alignment fields only take effect while this is on.

attributes.label: Background color
attributes.help: Only the rgb values are used for rendering. The remaining keys are kept for compatibility with the previous plugin.

attributes.label: Show overlay
attributes.help: Turns on the overlay layer, drawn above the background color. The overlay color below only takes effect while this is on.

attributes.label: Overlay color
attributes.help: Only the rgb values are used for rendering. The remaining keys are kept for compatibility with the previous plugin.

attributes.label: Horizontal background alignment
attributes.help: Aligns the background layer within its row when the background column width is narrower than the full row. Has no visible effect at full width.

attributes.label: Background utilities
attributes.help: Applies a Bootstrap background-color utility class to this block. If the background layer is switched on, it is drawn on top and hides this utility.

attributes.label: Text utilities
attributes.help: Applies a Bootstrap text-color utility class to this block, inherited by its content unless a nested block sets its own color.

attributes.label: Border utilities
attributes.help: Applies a Bootstrap border-color utility class to this block. Bootstrap's border utilities only show a border when a border width is also set, which this field does not add.

attributes.label: Link URL
attributes.help: Turns the whole div into a link. The anchor is rendered behind the content and covers the block.

attributes.label: Link title
attributes.help: Title attribute of the link created by the URL above. Shown as a tooltip by most browsers.

attributes.label: Link target
attributes.help: Controls whether the link created by the URL above opens in the same tab or a new one.

attributes.label: Link relationship
attributes.help: Value of the rel attribute on the link created by the URL above, for example nofollow or noopener.

attributes.label: Block ID
attributes.help: Unique identifier of this block. It links the block to its generated inline CSS and must not be changed.
